notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 is OUT NOW！
notes.content:
[b]Heaven Dust 2[/b] is out now on Steam and Nintendo Switch! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515900/2__Heaven_Dust_2/

We're so happy that we can finally bring this to you guys. Heaven Dust 2 is the sequel of our last title Heaven Dust, which will tell you another story of Steve. But if you're a new player for this series, it's totally fine! We hope everyone can enjoy it.

[url=https://indienova.com/corp/heavendust2/en]Game Page of Heaven Dust 2[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/6bdf4e882e93e8e442d499157030f0291d6fb9c4.png[/img]

Heaven Dust 2 is a survival horror game inspired by some classic titles and developed by One Gruel Studio, a two-person team. Heaven Dust 2 features exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management. You wake up from a cryogenic pod deep inside a research base and find yourself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies... will you be able to escape?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/7e287c376b04893c5f9b2a2532fa410c27537628.jpg[/img]

GAME FEATURES

[list]
[*] Classic survival horror genre: Heavy doses of exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management.
[*] Enhanced production value: Highly detailed graphics and effects, providing a brand new experience for players of the first game.
[*] Collect and combine, use various items to solve puzzles.
[*] Evolved combat system: Fight your way out with a dagger, submachine gun, shotgun, and grenades.
[*] Choose your weapon to counter different enemies, plan your strategy, seek their weak points, and destroy their defenses. Except for ordinary zombies, all kinds of mutated monsters have joined the battle too: Heavily armored Bone Fiend, regenerating Blood Fiend, approaching Boomlad.
[*] Epic boss fights. Engaging plot, fun brain teasers. Players need to make an ultimate choice: Two escape routes will lead you to two different endings. Casual, Normal, and Expert difficulties for you to choose, suited to all players.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/c880c61b868b1f63813635178bd66d1a53e7445b.png[/img]

You'll get a 10% discount if you buy Heaven Dust 2 in the first week. And also there is a Heaven Dust 1+2 Bundle which has a better price if you want to buy both Heaven Dust and Heaven Dust 2. Don't forget to check it.

BTW, every player who owned Heaven Dust could unlock a suit and a special weapon in Heaven Dust 2. Find it out in the game!

If you like this game, welcome to leave a review for it. Feel free to contact us in the Steam community if you get any problems. 

Press Contact:
Jesús Fabre, on behalf of Indienova
Email: me@jesusfabre.com

notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 will come out later this year
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/03380f8669c78892bf3939dee34396db80e085e3.png[/img]

Today, One Gruel Studio and indie games publisher indienova are excited to announce that the title of our new game Heaven Dust 2 will come out later this year if everything goes well, and here's a trailer based on the WIP build we are working on. If you like it, please add it to your wishlist, it will help a lot for us:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SW7brYnohCo

It's the sequel of our last game, the survival horror thriller Heaven Dust. (Stand-alone story that does not require playing the previous game.)

[h2]Story[/h2]

After a press conference, a virus leakage incident breaks out in the mysterious First Research Center.
In the meantime, deep inside of the institute, Steve wakes up from his freeze pod.
He finds himself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by preying walking deads, again.
Following the guidance, he must fight his way out of all the ferocious monsters.
When hope shines its light, the dreadful truth is also approaching...

"Are you ready to escape from the hell again, Steve?
Or should I call you... 'Second Host'."

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Classic survival horror genre, featuring: Exploration, Action, Puzzle, Resources Management.
[*] New development scale: Better graphics and effects, providing a brand new experience. Twice of the content of the first game, prepare to embark on a 10 hours journey.
[*] Collect and combine, use various items to solve puzzles. Upgrade your inventory. Weapons no longer occupy your space.
[*] Evolved combat system: Fight your way out with your dagger, submachine gun, shotgun, and grenade. Modify your weapons, upgrade them to the limit. Choose your weapon to counter different enemies, plan your strategy, seek their weak points, destroy their defenses.
[*] Except for the ordinary zombies, all kinds of mutated monsters had joined the battle too: Heavily armored Bone Fiend, regenerating Blood Fiend, approaching boomlad. And, of course, the epic boss fights.
[*] Engaging plot, fun brain teasers. The player needs to make an ultimate choice: Two escape routes will lead you to two different endings.
[*] Casual, Normal, and Expert difficulties for you to choose, suit to all players.
[/list]

notes.title: Heaven Dust Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35247158/b6df8967dc256d7fd15ef8b31cb1df73310f6907.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last update, we got a big patch this week with some fixes but a lot of new things as well. We will have a discount event with the most favorable price to celebrate this update from May 1st. Don't miss the chance if you didn't own this game.

After getting some feedback, we add a new end to this game finally.
And there are also some new interesting weapons and items which bring new gameplay for these players who love challenges.

Another good news is our trading cards with which you can unlock new emoticons and profile backgrounds are now available!

Hello, everyone!

Finally, "Heaven Dust" is available and the first day is over already.

First of all, we want to thank all of you. During the development of this game, we have always received the attention and support of many of you. We are also very grateful to all of you who bought the game for the first time, thank you for your encouragement, approval and criticism.

We've got an update to fix the minor bugs in the first version, so here's the change log:

BTW, we will appreciate a lot if you can leave a review on Steam after playing, it will really help us a lot.
Thanks again!

notes.title: Heaven Dust will launch on February 27th, 2020
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Nkk0B-7IqxI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey, everybody, it really takes us a long time to prepare launching Heaven Dust on Steam. And now, we are happy to announce that you will be able to play it on February 27th, which is not a far future, right?

Heaven Dust will come with English, German, Russian and Chinese version at first. We are still working on its Japanese localization and will make an update asap.

The price of Heaven Dust is $7.99, but if you buy it in the first week, you will get a 15% off discount. So put it in your wishlist and you will get an email when it launches :D

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1032590/Heaven_Dust/
 
As you see, Heaven Dust is deeply inspired by the classical famous game Resident Evil (or Bio Hazard in Japan).  The developers are the big fans of it, so they try to use a similar theme and some ideas. But the story, puzzles and most of the design are definitely new. So you may find some familiar taste and a totally new fresh experience in Heaven Dust.

At the beginning of the game, players will find themselves waking up in a strange mansion full of horrible zombies and deadly traps. What you need to do is collecting helpful items, solving innovative puzzles, fighting with zombies and trying to find out what happened.
 
In 1970, a scientific investigation team found a new virus in the blood samples from a primitive tribe called "Torkue" in New Guinea. Some scientists think it will help to reveal the secret of immortality and they called it "Heaven Dust". However, it turns out that it's not really a gift from Heaven, it opens the gate to hell instead.
 
After the research center in New Guinea was destroyed in an accident related to the mutant virus, they brought "Heaven Dust" to the USA, then the researches were carried out entirely by their subsidiary company StarDust.
 
A disaster is just unfolding...
 
The Team
[list]
[*] Developer: One Gruel Studio
[*] Publisher: indienova
[/list]
 
Key Facts
[list]
[*] Platform: Steam, Nintendo Switch
[*] Release Date: February 27th, 2020
[*] Genre: Survival Horror, Puzzle.
[/list]
 
Features：
[list]
[*] Thrilling and immersive exploration-horror experience!
[*] Challenging story-integrated puzzles!
[*] A hopeless story with different endings. Maybe there is a good one.
[*] We try to keep the best things together, you will expect to find in a small package.
[/list]
 
This game is from a two-man studio from China and it's their debut. You can give its demo a try first if you are not very sure if you want to buy this game: [url=https://indienova.itch.io/heaven-dust]https://indienova.itch.io/heaven-dust[/url]

You may have heard from the news that there are many infected persons with the novel coronavirus confirmed in China. They are not only numbers, but they are also real human lives. We made this decision after careful consideration: though undermined by the situation as well, we won't delay the launch date, as we hope the hopeless story for teaching courage can also help us deal with the struggles and fears of our everyday lives with the plague.
